summary: Added D-pad flashlight aim offsets to examples/flashlight/run.py with bounded yaw and pitch controls defaulting to +/-30 degrees, using the existing safe FKey dict polling pattern.
work_completed: Added CLI arguments: --aim-yaw-min-degrees, --aim-yaw-max-degrees, --aim-pitch-min-degrees, --aim-pitch-max-degrees, --aim-rate-degrees-per-second, and configurable D-pad key names.
Implemented hold-based D-pad input: left/right adjust yaw offset, up/down adjust pitch offset, clamped to configured bounds at the configured rate.
Kept toggle key behavior, pose capture, Enter capture, camera movement, and existing capture polling intact.
Ran syntax verification: python -m py_compile examples/flashlight/run.py.
Manual runtime controls: D-pad Left/Right aim yaw, D-pad Up/Down aim pitch, Gamepad_FaceButton_Right toggles flashlight, Enter or capture key captures poses when --capture-poses is enabled.

findings.message: Syntax verification passed with python -m py_compile examples/flashlight/run.py.

follow_up_recommendations: Manual in-engine verification is still recommended to confirm the Unreal controller key names map to the target gamepad on the runtime platform.
